study: Task-trained spiking owner, causal resource credit and joint surrogate meta-learning

training.objective: One hard-SNN SG support step, followed by fixed logistic-soft query BCE. All arms use the same query gradient for a weight update; only meta_theta also updates the three raw surrogate parameters.
training.outer_derivative_scope: Analytic one-step derivative of query loss through support adaptation, including clipping and projection; not a derivative through the later query weight update or all training history.
training.model_selection: None: the final registered update is deployed. Screening outcomes cannot revise the method or confirmation protocol.

datasets.truth_use: Support/query supervision and evaluator scoring only; never an owner observation input.
datasets.neural_cost_feature: Visible base observation cost; resource price changes only the stopping boundary.

credit.work: One actually executed observation/native-owner tick plus actual SNN spikes divided by eight. Raw-belief policies execute no SNN cells or spikes. Native, solver, memory and replay work is additionally measured, not relabeled as this budget unit or Joules.
credit.price_update: clip(p + eta * (episode_work - budget - kappa * terminal_reward), 0, pmax)
credit.balance_update: Debit actual work on each tick. At terminal settlement add budget + kappa * terminal_reward, capped at balance_cap, recording any overflow.
credit.admission: Reserve the conservative quote before buying an observation; insufficient balance terminates without another native tick.
credit.causality: Price is fixed inside an episode and updated only by its terminal measured work and reward; all three credit arms use the same actual balance accounting and admission rule.
credit.native_credit_binding: Call the original learning-ledger causal credit finalizer on the terminal outcome and conserved organ allocation; resource accounting is a separate research sidecar, not production authenticated LedgerWriter admission.

deployment.budget_order: First block uses 3 and second 7; reverse for odd confirmation-seed index.
deployment.authority: Original native DENY_ALL plus explicit local synthetic research permit; no production permission expansion.

statistics.unit: Independent confirmation training/environment seed; 16 episodes per seed/arm/split remain within-seed observations.
statistics.primary_metric: Mean terminal reward minus all purchased observation costs, including abstention and forced budget stops.
statistics.interval: Two paired Student-t intervals with Bonferroni adjustment, each 97.5% two-sided.
statistics.superiority_rule: Each named claim requires its adjusted lower bound above 0.005. Functional acceptance does not imply efficacy superiority.
statistics.secondary: All other paired contrasts, work/coverage/forced stops, price and balance trajectories, and ID outcomes are descriptive; retain zero and negative results.

execution.initial_environment_assets: Existing Python, NumPy/SciPy and Rust toolchain are declared pre-existing assets; all new verification, dependency preparation and builds are timed. Historical unmeasured setup is not reconstructed.
execution.large_raw_evidence: Preserve the complete natural raw directory and exact executable in a dedicated downloadable artifact with a published digest; Git retains source, protocols, indices, statistics and small audit receipts.
